patch_description: Retry with corrected SEARCH text (the docstring says "Size of the sliding window", not "(W samples)"). Same two edits: (1) add a bidirectional Kalman fusion helper (validated in Gens 62/65/68 to cancel interior phase error with zero smoothness cost) and use it in Stage 1; (2) steepen the recency-weight tilt from -1.0 to -1.5 to compensate the group delay of the wide 2W+11 SG window. Both target the lag (0.47) and accuracy (0.75) regressions while preserving the smoothness gains (slope changes 14.6).
